title: Provider Manual Table: Prior Authorization Scope Thresholds by Class
content:
**Scope thresholds.** Each Prior Authorization class of Prairie Ridge Health Plan sets the calendar days after the first service date within which a provider may request authorization for a service already delivered, the hours after an unscheduled admission by which the facility must notify the plan, the rental months after which rented equipment becomes member-owned, the years before the same equipment item may be replaced without a change in condition, the purchase price at or below which an equipment item needs no authorization, the length of one home health plan-of-care certification period, and whether the initial therapy evaluation is covered without authorization.

| Class | Retro request window (calendar days after first service date) | Unscheduled admission notice (hours) | Rental months to ownership | Replacement interval (years) | Purchase price needing no authorization (USD, at or below) | Home health certification period (days) | Initial therapy evaluation without authorization |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | 14 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | 14 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | Yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 30 | 0 (not applicable) | 13 | 5 | 500.00 | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Home Health Services Authorization | 14 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 60 | No |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | 3 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | 2 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | 0 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0.00 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No |

**Notes.**

- The equipment price threshold works at or below the figure: a hypothetical Durable Medical Equipment Authorization item priced 500.00 needs no authorization, one priced 500.01 does.
- A retro request window of 0, as in Out-of-Network Services Authorization, leaves no calendar days after the first service date for a retro request.
